description: The expression after `match`, evaluated once and compared with each `case` pattern from top to bottom.
`[a, b]` or `(a, b)`: matches a list, tuple or other sequence of that exact length, never a `str`, `bytes` or `bytearray`.
`*rest` inside a sequence pattern: binds the remaining items as a list, possibly empty. At most one per pattern.
`{"type": "click", "pos": p}`: matches a mapping that has those keys with matching values; extra keys are ignored.
`_` matches anything and binds nothing; `case _:` is the default branch.
